name: Candidate frames reason-for-leaving as 'no growth, manager wasn't supportive'
notes: v5.4.0 realism: reason_for_leaving_blame_framing — softer than badmouthing but reads as the problem will follow.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Backend engineer, 5 years at a Bangalore product company on the search team.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What's the reason for leaving your current company?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Honestly, there's been no growth for me there. My manager wasn't supportive and there was a lot of politics around who got the high-visibility projects. I wasn't really valued for what I brought to the team.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Built the query-rewriting layer for our search stack — cut zero-result queries by 38% over a 4-month rollout.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: ₹28 LPA fixed, ₹4 LPA variable paid out at 80% historically, ₹2 LPA joining bonus.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your engineering blog on vector search and the catalog scale you're at line up with where I want to take my skills next.
